title: Frodo and pillows
statementMd:
$*n*$ hobbits are planning to spend the night at Frodo's house. Frodo has $*n*$ beds standing in a row and $*m*$ pillows ($*n* ≤ *m*$). Each hobbit needs a bed and at least one pillow to sleep, however, everyone wants as many pillows as possible. Of course, it's not always possible to share pillows equally, but any hobbit gets hurt if he has at least two pillows less than some of his neighbors have.

Frodo will sleep on the $*k*$-th bed in the row. What is the maximum number of pillows he can have so that every hobbit has at least one pillow, every pillow is given to some hobbit and no one is hurt?

## Input

The only line contain three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$) — the number of hobbits, the number of pillows and the number of Frodo's bed.

## Output

Print single integer — the maximum number of pillows Frodo can have so that no one is hurt.

## Note

In the first example Frodo can have at most two pillows. In this case, he can give two pillows to the hobbit on the first bed, and one pillow to each of the hobbits on the third and the fourth beds.

In the second example Frodo can take at most four pillows, giving three pillows to each of the others.

In the third example Frodo can take three pillows, giving two pillows to the hobbit in the middle and one pillow to the hobbit on the third bed.
statementZhMd:
$*n*$ 个霍比特人计划在弗罗多家过夜。弗罗多有 $*n*$ 张排成一排的床和 $*m*$ 个枕头（$*n* ≤ *m*$）。每个霍比特人都需要一张床和至少一个枕头才能睡觉，但每个人都希望拥有尽可能多的枕头。当然，枕头不一定能平均分配，但如果某个霍比特人比他的某个邻居少至少两个枕头，他就会感到不满。

弗罗多将睡在这一排床中的第 $*k*$ 张床上。为了让每个霍比特人至少有一个枕头、所有枕头都分配给某个霍比特人，并且没有人感到不满，弗罗多最多能拥有多少个枕头？

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）——霍比特人的数量、枕头的数量以及弗罗多所在的床的编号。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——在没有人感到不满的情况下，弗罗多最多能拥有的枕头数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，弗罗多最多可以拥有两个枕头。在这种情况下，他可以给睡在第一张床上的霍比特人两个枕头，并给睡在第三张和第四张床上的霍比特人各一个枕头。

在第二个样例中，弗罗多最多可以拿到四个枕头，并给其他每个人各三个枕头。

在第三个样例中，弗罗多可以拿到三个枕头，给睡在中间床上的霍比特人两个枕头，并给睡在第三张床上的霍比特人一个枕头。
